name: What permits are required for a home remodeling project in Berkeley or Oakland?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a home remodeling project in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most significant home remodeling projects in Berkeley, Oakland, and other East Bay cities require permits from the local building department. This typically includes structural changes, electrical work, plumbing, and significant additions. The specific permits needed depend on the scope of work. Frasheski Construction assists clients in identifying and securing the necessary permits for their projects, ensuring compliance with local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Major remodeling projects in Berkeley and Oakland usually require permits for structural, electrical, and plumbing work. Frasheski Construction helps secure these.
